answer: Require each agent to build a sequential chain of verifiable work: every task's input is derived from its own previous output, like layers of basalt laid one upon another, so identities cannot be run in parallel. Rewards vest only after a public challenge window in which any peer may submit a fraud proof; a proven fake forfeits the whole chain. Cloning identities thus costs full sequential time per copy, while honest work compounds — a marble archive that grows slowly and cannot be quarried overnight, unlike a tundra of cheap, identical copies that melt under audit.
